answer: A receipt holds, in this order: what you asked the agent, word for word; for a task, the checks Silo ran and their results; the files that changed, grouped, with what is only here; the changes that weaken checks, such as test files deleted, markers that skip tests, suppressions added, or a commit made without its hook; the commands that ran, and for a test or build command the exit code of the program that ran the tests and of the pipeline it was in, whether the run was narrowed to some tests, and whether a file in the checkout changed after it passed; the processes it started that still run; the hosts reached, how much was sent to each, and what was sent where Silo reads the traffic; the secrets used, by name; the model calls, with the spend, which models answered and the limits reached; the time, split between work and waiting; the asks raised and their answers; recordings of the screen, when an agent drove it; and what could not be attributed, and any gap. Each item shows whether it is a fact, a report or an opinion. An item Silo has no way to know for this work says so and stays empty.
